Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Wikipedia page by accepting the lead sentence claiming “born in Piedmont, Italy” while ignoring the same page’s “Life” section stating Vincent Novello was born at 240 Oxford Street, London. This premature adoption of the conflicting snippet without reconciling internal inconsistencies or cross-checking could have led to the incorrect birthplace, whereas authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica, DNB) confirm London.
